task: Phase 2 Task 5 - Authoritative Sliding Window Overlap Audit

source_reconstruction.split_rule: First int(0.31 * total_windows) windows are test; remainder are train.

filtering.rule: Retain a window only if at least one pedestrian ID occurs in all 12 frames; retain only common IDs.

limitations: Reconstructed from the original all_frame_data pickle, not the CSV timeline.
The split is chronological within one HBS scene, not scene-independent.
Temporal overlap remains possible across the train/test boundary.
